text:
Our national parks belong to all of us, and so do the tax dollars we spend to protect them.

And yet the Trump Administration has blocked at least $25 MILLION in funding for more than 130 projects.

To be clear, this wasn’t money they were still waiting on. We are talking about money that had already been secured for work at some of the most visited parks in the country.

Interior says the projects didn’t align with Administration priorities. But it hasn’t explained why the money was rejected or where it’s going instead.

Our parks need maintenance, they need wildfire protection, and they need people doing the work that keeps them safe and open for your next visit. Everything about this goes against that and the law.
https://t.co/NKYvjZ7vk0
